rotation.basis: day-of-year 288 (2026-10-15), day-of-month 15; pool size 34. Yesterday (doy 287) emphasized pool indices 28-33 + 0-10 (radiology/imaging, drug trials, pathology, documentation, ED triage, sepsis, EHR, SaMD, hospital deployment, licensing exam, Korean four). Today emphasizes the complementary slice, indices 11-27 (17 keywords: prior auth, mental health therapy, dermatology, ophthalmology, cardiology ECG, oncology planning, protein design drug trial, antibiotic discovery, surgical robots, patient safety/bias, LLM CDS, genomics diagnosis, telehealth, nursing workload, liability, vaccine design, rare disease).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; the other 17 (yesterday's slice) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - drop unless a named disease, patient, clinician or institution is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel (even at hospitals, unless care changes), supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it for another story, do not reword. Treatment/diagnosis/vaccine development is fine (AI antibiotic discovery and AI vaccine design keywords: keep to therapeutic/clinical framing only).

plan_notes: For the librarian: (1) LEAD WITH OUTLET RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (statnews, fiercehealthcare, fiercebiotech, healthcareitnews, mobihealthnews, medcitynews, endpts, biopharmadive, healthcaredive, radiologybusiness, auntminnie, beckershospitalreview, nature.com Nature Medicine / npj Digital Medicine / Nature Health / Nature BME, ai.nejm.org, jamanetwork, bmj, fda.gov press, dailypharm, docdocdoc, medigatenews, bosa). Use the queries above only to fill gaps - site: search tends to return evergreen pages. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-15); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword; therapeutic/diagnostic/vaccine development is fine. (5) Skip anything in rotation.recently_published_avoid and same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result; deprioritize more radiology items today (5 of the last ~28 cards were prostate/breast/lung imaging). (6) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
